messages.author: 232ea38fda21e4b9
messages.subject: funtion nb not found
parts:
Hello,

I am trying to fit a dsm. 

dsm_nb_2 <- dsm(count ~ s(HSDens, bs ="ts") +
                       s(HsEucDist, bs ="ts") +
                       s(AECEucDist, bs ="ts") +
                       s(AECDens, bs ="ts") +
                       s(AProtDist, bs ="ts") +
                       s(CamBorderDist, bs ="ts") +
                       s(CamCongoBorderDist, bs ="ts") +
                       s(MajH2ODist, bs ="ts") +
                       s(SecRdDist, bs ="ts") +
                       s(Elev, bs ="ts") +
                       s(Slope, bs ="ts"),
                  df_hr_All, segs, obs,
                  family = nb(), method = "REML")

I get the warning, 
Error in dsm(count ~ s(HSDens, bs = "ts") + s(HsEucDist, bs = "ts") +  : could not find function "nb"

Any help is appreciated!

Sarah

messages.author: 75e0b0abcbafbc7d
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] funtion nb not found
parts:
Sarah


I see you are trying to duplicate the sperm whale analysis described by Dave Miller in his spatial modelling workshop exercises.  I don't see any syntax errors in the code you have provide, I am left to suggest that perhaps you might not have the most recent version of the mgcv package to apply the negative binomial.  I'm not sure when nb() came into mgcv, but simplest to update all the necessary packages via:


install.packages(c("Distance", "dsm", "ggplot2", "knitr", "plyr",
                   "raster", "reshape2", "rgdal", "viridis",
                   "htmltools", "caTools", "bitops", "rmarkdown",
                   "tweedie"))

Hope that is useful.
